lines.text: ان قاعده اکثر حکم کل دارد و بنا بر این بعضی سال پانزدهم را کبیسه خوانند چو کسر در انسال
lines.en: That rule mostly has a general application, and therefore some call the fifteenth year a leap year, since the fraction in that year

lines.text: نصف است و بعضی از سال شانزدهم کبیسه کنند چه کسر در انسال از نصف زیاده است
lines.en: is a half, and some make the leap year from the sixteenth year, since the fraction in that year is more than a half.

lines.text: و ما اینجا بجدول اورده ایم و در انجا بازاء هر سالی از این سی سال کسور زاید را
lines.en: And we have brought it here in a table, and there, opposite each year of these thirty years, the excess fractions

lines.text: ثبت کردیم بعد از حذف شبانروز چون آن کسور شبانروز شود یا بیشتر رقم
lines.en: we have recorded, after removing the day and night. When those fractions become a day and night or more, the number

lines.text: عدد هر سالی که روز زایده دارد بواد نوشته
lines.en: of the number of each year that has an excess day is written in the column

lines.text: شده و باقی بحره اما کبیسه مشهوره انست که
lines.en: and the rest in the fraction. But the famous leap year is that which

lines.text: ماخوذ از کبس است بمعنی پر کردن چاه از خاک
lines.en: is derived from 'kabs', meaning filling a well with earth,

lines.text: چه آن روزیست که از کسور جمع کرده اند و
lines.en: since it is a day that they have collected from fractions and

lines.text: بعضی گفته اند که کبس در اوردن سر است
lines.en: some have said that 'kabs' is bringing in the head

lines.text: در گریبان که ابزور بست که محاسب در میان
lines.en: into the collar, which is a metaphor for the calculator among

lines.text: ایام سال در اورده است چنانچه سر در گریبان
lines.en: the days of the year has brought in, just as the head in the collar

lines.text: در اورند و کبیسه بمعنی مکبوس است صفت
lines.en: they bring in. And 'kabisa' means 'makbus' (filled/inserted), an adjective

lines.text: روز است و باینمعنی علامت نقل است از
lines.en: for the day, and in this sense it is a sign of transfer from

lines.text: صفت باسمیت و بعضی انسال را گویند
lines.en: adjective to noun, and some call that year

lines.text: که کبیسه در او واقع شود بمجاز کبیسه گویند
lines.en: in which the leap year occurs, metaphorically, a leap year.

lines.text: و مبداء این تاریخ از زمان هجرت پیغمبر
lines.en: And the origin of this era is from the time of the migration of the Prophet,

lines.text: صلی الله علیه و آله از مکه معظمه بمدینه طیبه
lines.en: may God bless him and his family, from the great Mecca to the good Medina,

lines.text: شرفها الله تعالی روز اوّل محرم انسالیکه هجرت فرموده اند و هجرت در لغت ترک
lines.en: may God Almighty honor it, the first day of Muharram of the year in which they migrated. And migration in the dictionary is leaving

lines.text: وطنست و مفارقت از ان بموضع دیگر و مقام ساختن در ان و بحسب عرف مخصوص
lines.en: the homeland and separating from it to another place and making a residence there, and according to custom it is specific

summary.headline: Leap Years and the Hijri Era
summary.text: Explanation of the thirty-year leap-year cycle, including competing calculations for the fifteenth or sixteenth year and the derivation of kabīs from accumulated fractional days. The discussion then defines the Hijri era from the Prophet’s migration from Mecca to Medina, beginning on the first of Muharram.
